label: Round Elbow Patch
description: A round elbow patch is a classic oval or circular panel of leather, suede, or matching fabric stitched over the elbow point of the sleeve, providing reinforcement at the precise location where repeated flexion and abrasion wear through cloth first. On tweed, flannel, and corduroy sport coats this detail carries rich associations with country pursuits, academic life, and a deliberately relaxed form of elegance. In suede or tan leather against a heather tweed, the patch adds a warm tonal contrast that elevates the jacket from mere clothing to an object of considered character.
